tight_delay.derivation: A=0.12; residual processing budget0.002; G>=0.12/0.002=60 > L20.

consistency_only: The toy export is compared with C04 numerical routines, supplemented with literal analytical fixtures. This is not C08 independent full-model validation. Original-unit row thresholds, aggregate inactive-error counterexamples and all raw/decoded adversarial families must still pass there.
source_coefficients: Authored radio coefficients require analytical_fixture classification and a complete positive domain. They are copied as explicit inputs. C08 must take the original trusted coefficient fixture separately, not trust rates written in the candidate export. Production toy uses the physical radio equations.
